entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi... uhm, I hope I'm in the right place. I think I need to return something. I'm a bit confused by the website.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Flores. The order number is... VF7-881-9024.

Thank you, Maria. I'm pulling that up now. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th, which was 18 days ago. To understand how I can best help, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... we had an emergency. I bought this for my daughter before her deployment, but she ended up in the hospital. She needed emergency surgery, and everything has been a blur.
I haven't even had a moment to look at the box, and now her deployment date is here. I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me? I'm so overwhelmed.

Of course, Maria. I am so sorry to hear about your daughter. That sounds incredibly stressful, and I hope she's doing better now. Please don't worry, let me check the return eligibility for you right now.
Okay, I'm looking at our policy... and yes, you're perfectly fine. It looks like you're well within the return window.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I had missed the deadline with everything going on.

Not at all. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since it's only been 18 days, we can get this processed for you immediately. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email right now. Is the address on file still correct?
Yes, it is. Thank you so, so much, Alex. You have no idea what a relief this is.
You are very welcome, Maria. I'm glad I could make this one part a little easier for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your daughter a speedy recovery and a safe deployment.
